body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage; you or an adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit into a space adjacent to you.

surges.html: The moving creature may swap spaces with you instead.
On a hit, reduce the target's next forced movement of either creature by 2 units until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: If you end adjacent to a willing ally, gain 1 Combo even on a miss. You may spend it when that ally is pushed before your next turn to reduce the push by 1.
